name: Microsuchus
isnote: Originally named as a goniopholid; English Wikipedia places it in Notosuchia; placed in Mesoeucrocodylia as in PBDB.
sum: Microsuchus is a notosuchian mesoeucrocodylian from the Santonian Bajo de la Carpa Formation of Argentina.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Remains from the Bajo de la Carpa Formation.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Saez 1928
